def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 3, 2, 5, 7, 8, 1, 4, 6, 9)]
    # The marker is the sole non-background/nonzero color set; locate its color by finding a color other than 0/background.
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    # In these tasks, the marker is the color other than the dominant background color.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(v for v in counts if v != background)
    coords = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0=min(r for r,c in coords); c0=min(c for r,c in coords)
    pattern={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in coords}
    ph=max(r for r,c in pattern)+1; pw=max(c for r,c in pattern)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-ph+1):
        for c in range(w-pw+1):
            cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in pattern]
            if all(grid[x][y] == 0 for x,y in cells):
                for x,y in cells: out[x][y]=marker
    return out
